data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened the year with gross claims outstanding of GBP 350.458m. The syndicate reports a net surplus of GBP 14.029m relating to the reassessment of claims for prior accident years, indicating a release on prior-year reserves (net basis). No explicit gross prioryear movement is presented; the report quantifies the prior-year movement on a net-of-reinsurance basis only. Separately, COVID-19 contributed a quantified net impact during the year, and other class-specific movements (e.g. engineering losses, property favourables) are discussed but not quantified as gross prioryear movements.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) is presented in the notes. The report explicitly quantifies a NET prioryear surplus of GBP 14.029m; per instructions this NET figure has been used as a last-resort fallback. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Liabilities: Claims outstanding). A gross claims development table is present but the report does not state a consolidated gross prior-year movement amount; triangle was parsed but some development cells for recent years are necessarily null. Part VII transfer of EEA policies occurred on 30 Dec 2020 (no net economic impact) - triangle may be influenced in future reporting periods.
